reasoning_trace: Second independent injection of this fault type, again explicitly checking for the Kafka-lag confound documented in this project's earlier history. Traced 14 payments across the full 30s window. All show routing-execution completing promptly (RAIL_SELECTED and PAYMENT_ROUTED both fire within roughly 5-15ms of AML screening completing) for every payment that reaches that stage, with a handful of normal business PAYMENT_REJECTED outcomes at validation -- not stalls. Every traced payment stops cleanly right after PAYMENT_ROUTED; none show SETTLEMENT_COMPLETE. The independent health witness corroborates: settlement DOWN, then RECOVERED. As with the first case of this fault type (LIVE-0fbc4973), the documented confound risk did not manifest here either -- clean, unambiguous evidence. Conclusion reached from evidence alone, before reading the injector's own log: settlement.
confirmation_basis: Blind conclusion (settlement) matches the injector's own ground-truth log exactly.
